scope: Post-hoc construction diagnostic; no policy update, efficacy claim, future outcome read or model/tool contact.
boundary: After the fixed first Perception and initial default20 supply, before the first Solver request. Not available at episode start.
analysis: Use the shared bounded candidate projection and agreement function on the actual prefix.
Check first-Perception response custody and first-Solver request hashes and ordering.
Compare initial request exemplar IDs to the historical whole-episode union; future supply is not an actor feature.
Report state occupancy, missing-boundary rows, repeated-state stability and pre-action evidence/candidate changes.
Keep official terminal feedback in a separate diagnostic join; report natural/equal-scenario and per-scenario outcomes.
Do not choose policy winners or tune thresholds from these labels; do not interpret repeats as alternative actions.

sparse_diagnostic.allocation: Expected balanced counts for planning only, not realized coverage or power.

knowledge_snapshot_hash_semantics: Shared KnowledgeSnapshot.content_hash, not serialized-file SHA; record both in output.
